card.line: Mount Hermon is a tall, snow-capped mountain at Israel's northern edge, a landmark that marked the edge of the land God gave His people.

moments.title: Israel takes the land east of the Jordan
moments.text: Moses tells how Israel took the land from the Arnon Valley as far as Mount Hermon from the two Amorite kings. He notes that the Sidonians call it Sirion and the Amorites call it Senir.

moments.title: Joshua conquers the north
moments.text: Joshua took the land and struck down all its kings. His conquest reached Baal-gad in the Valley of Lebanon, at the foot of Mount Hermon.

moments.title: Hermon in Manasseh's land
moments.text: The half-tribe of Manasseh grew large and settled from Bashan to Baal-hermon, which is also called Senir and Mount Hermon.

moments.title: Hermon shouts for joy
moments.text: The psalmist praises God as Creator of north and south. He says Tabor and Hermon shout for joy at God's name.

moments.title: Dew of Hermon
moments.text: The psalm compares the joy of God's people living together in unity to the dew of Hermon falling on the mountains of Zion. There the LORD has bestowed the blessing of life forevermore.
